description:
Welcome to back to TruthTalk TV, a channel dedicated to solving relationship problems from around the country! Our latest submission comes from a Joo Do-Hee, young woman torn between her ex and her childhood best friend. She writes: “Dear TruthTalk TV, my ex and I ended our four-year relationship because he couldn’t keep up with me in the bedroom. So, I drunkenly slept with my best friend one night, and it was everything I ever could have hoped for! The only problem? He’s always had feelings for me, and I think that our night together only made him fall even more in love. And now my ex is crawling back, asking for one more chance to do me…I mean, our relationship…right! What should I do?!” What do you think, dear subscribers? Should Do-Hee give her ex another chance to get in her pants? Or is her new fling the real thing? Keep tuning in to find out!

(Source: Lezhin US)
